'''Pylokam's Health Food''' was a booth that sold health [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] marketplace. It was run by an older [[Human/Legends|human]] named [[Pylokam]]. 

==Description==
The booth sold both [[Fruit juice/Legends|fruit juices]] and steamed balls of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] gratings. All the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for sale was noted to be free of [[Sugar/Legends|sugars]], [[Salt/Legends|salts]], and [[Wikipedia:Food additive|artificial additives]]. It was also known for its immense unprofitablity, with the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Feltipern Trevagg]] noting that not even [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] sought to take a percentage of its virtually nonexistent profit.<ref name="Nightlily" />

==History==
The booth was opened several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Nightlily" /> 

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was a known customer during his [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Nightlily" />
